connection_condition: Within the major table, each department value determines exactly one college value; no department is recorded under more than one college.
description: A college is composed of departments; every department belongs to exactly one college.

connection_condition: Within the major table, each major_name value determines exactly one department value.
description: A department is composed of majors; every major belongs to exactly one department.

connection_condition: member.link_to_major references major.major_id; one member holds at most one major and one major is held by many members.
description: A major is composed of the club members enrolled in it; a member's academic affiliation is expressed through their major.

connection_condition: budget.link_to_event references event.event_id and is never empty.
description: An event is composed of budget lines; each budget line allocates money for one spending category of that event.

connection_condition: expense.link_to_budget references budget.budget_id and is never empty.
description: A budget line is composed of the expense transactions charged against it; each expense consumes the category budget it is charged to.

connection_condition: Indirect: an expense reaches its event only through expense.link_to_budget and budget.link_to_event; the expense table has no direct event reference.
description: Expenses are attributable to the event whose budget lines they consume, but only indirectly via the budget table.

connection_condition: attendance.link_to_event references event.event_id and is never empty.
description: An event is composed of attendance records; each record states that a member attended that event.

connection_condition: attendance.link_to_member references member.member_id and is never empty.
description: A member accumulates attendance records; each record states that the member attended a particular event.

connection_condition: income.link_to_member optionally references member.member_id; club-level receipts (Fundraising, School Appropration, Sponsorship) carry no member, so the link is not mandatory.
description: Income receipts may be attributed to the member who paid them, but club-level receipts belong to the club rather than to a person.

connection_condition: member.zip and zip_code.zip_code hold the same postal-code value domain; all 33 member.zip values resolve to a zip_code row.
description: The ZIP code stored on a member and the ZIP code reference record denote the same postal code concept.

connection_condition: budget.event_status and event.status share the value domain Closed/Open/Planning and agree on all 52 budget rows.
description: The event status recorded on a budget line expresses the same concept as the event's own status; either column can carry a lifecycle-state filter.

connection_condition: full_name is formed by concatenating member.first_name and member.last_name.
description: A member's full name is derived from the first name and last name stored on the member record.

connection_condition: The event's expense cost aggregates expense.cost over the expenses charged to that event's budget lines.
description: The total cost of an event is derived by summing the costs of the expenses attributed to that event.

connection_condition: cost_share_percentage is the event's expense cost divided by the total expense cost across all events, multiplied by 100.
description: An event's share of cost is derived by dividing that event's expense cost by the total expense cost of all events.

connection_condition: The percentage equals the counted or summed subset divided by the relevant total, multiplied by 100; the scope is fixed by the question.
description: A reported percentage or proportion is derived from a subset quantity and the total it is measured against.

connection_condition: dues_payment selects the subset of income rows whose source is Dues.
description: A dues payment is a specific kind of income receipt, distinguished by its source value.

connection_condition: SUM(budget.spent) and SUM(expense.cost) both equal 2086.05 across the whole database, so the two aggregates measure the same money at different grains (budget line versus transaction).
description: The total amount spent against budgets and the total recorded expense cost express the same money-actually-spent concept.
